svg.title: A countermovement jump from the SDK's simulator
svg.desc: Total vertical force of both plates over time: standing at 750 N, a dip, a push-off to about 1800 N, 0.45 s in the air at 0 N, and a landing spike. Jump height from flight time is about 0.25 m. Simulated.

text.tspan: A countermovement jump, as the SDK delivers it
Simulated, not measured: movetrics-fdt simulate --signal cmj, body weight 750 N, 2,000 samples per second per plate.
